baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural resting places and their woven modifier operate together.
baseline_models.mechanism: A place that bears reclining bodies gains its stability from tightly interlaced parts; comfort is presented as engineered cohesion rather than ornament alone.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the literal support on which occupants settle and recline.
Makes interlacing the load-bearing construction of that support.

changed_reading.before: Luxurious couches distinguished chiefly by decoration.
changed_reading.after: Repose borne by a deliberately integrated, mutually reinforcing construction.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The couch noun shares its focus root with inward gladness and concealed interiority.
baseline_models.mechanism: The resting place can externalize an inward condition: latent ease becomes a durable woven environment that holds and displays it without exhausting its interior depth.

activation_trace.role: Adds inward gladness and ease to the literal place of repose.
Keeps an interior, not-fully-exposed dimension alive within the couch lexeme.
Turns that inward ease into a coherent material surround.

changed_reading.after: A woven spatial embodiment of the occupants' inward ease and gladness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sequence destabilizes, comminutes, and scatters the world's massive supports; the focus then supplies a support whose firmness comes from binding many parts together. The couches enact a material reversal from disaggregation to composed cohesion.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the reversal in an actual place of bodily support.
Supplies tight interconnection as the focus-side counterforce to dispersal.
Introduces violent motion that removes the reliability of the former ground.
Contributes the breaking and mixing stage between stable mass and particles.
Completes the destructive trajectory by distributing the particles apart.

structural_cues: The ordered movement in 56:4-6 is from ground instability through pulverization to dispersion.
The focus places bodily support after that collapse and after the human sorting of 56:7-14.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shaking, fragmentation, scattering, support, and interweaving; I infer a directional reversal from cosmic disassembly to constructed cohesion. A live alternative is simple contrast between destruction and luxury with no reconstructive arrow.

changed_reading.before: Woven couches as static luxury after the judgment scene.
changed_reading.after: New supports whose interconnection materially answers the prior world's shaking and dispersal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The lowering-and-raising polarity becomes socially determinate when precedence leads to privileged nearness. Being placed upon the couches therefore materializes a reassigned rank and admitted proximity, not leisure in an unmarked location.

activation_trace.role: Provides the installed station on which the newly ranked occupants settle.
Supplies downward reassignment as one pole of the scene's rank reversal.
Contributes elevation of standing, allowing the focus support to mark rank.
Identifies precedence as the occupants' differentiating relation.
Sharpens nearness into favored access, giving the couches a court-like positional force.

structural_cues: The indefinite lowering and raising of 56:3 is specified by the named forerunners and near ones in 56:10-11.
The preposition in the focus locates those occupants upon, rather than merely beside, the supports.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rank reversal, precedence, favored nearness, and placement on supports; I infer that the furniture installs the resulting status. It may instead mark comfort without carrying institutional rank.

changed_reading.before: Couches as interchangeable amenities of bliss.
changed_reading.after: Installed stations that make elevation, precedence, and admitted nearness spatially visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following ayat assign the couches three functions: they bear bodily reliance, orient occupants face-to-face, and serve as centers of circulation. Their interweaving can thus characterize a relational topology in which stable nodes support mutual visibility and moving service.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the plural stable nodes around which the social arrangement forms.
Offers interconnection as the focus image for joining those nodes into one arrangement.
Confirms that the supports receive the occupants' bodily weight and reliance.
Turns plural occupants toward one another as an interacting group.
Adds an orbit of service around the seated group instead of a static furniture display.

structural_cues: The pronoun in 56:16 refers bodily reliance back to the focus couches.
Mutual facing immediately follows the focus, and circulation around the occupants follows next.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies support, mutual orientation, and encircling movement; I extend the focus's material weave into a spatial and social network. The adjective may remain purely artisanal while the same geometry still follows from 56:16-17.

changed_reading.before: A collection of individually occupied luxury couches.
changed_reading.after: A coordinated seating network that joins repose, reciprocal encounter, and circulating provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus root's interior and private-speech potential is activated by a later auditory boundary: mixed futile noise is excluded, while spoken peace alone circulates. The woven setting becomes a socially maintained interior whose safety is produced by what may pass between occupants.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the model in the focus root's protected interior and confidential register.
Supplies the binding image for a setting held together by regulated exchange.
Defines the boundary through the occupants' actual auditory field.
Names the mixed noise excluded from the shared interior.
Supplies voiced utterance as the permitted medium moving among occupants.
Makes freedom from harm the repeated content of that permitted speech.

structural_cues: The exclusion formula of 56:25 is followed by the exception formula of 56:26.
The doubled peace utterance answers the face-to-face arrangement established in 56:16.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an interior focus-root branch, interweaving, auditory exclusion, and repeated safe speech; I infer a speech-governed social enclosure. A live alternative is that 56:25-26 describes the garden generally, not the couches' immediate zone.

changed_reading.after: The physical anchor of a protected conversational interior woven from harmless reciprocal speech.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This transfers the protected-pearl image onto the couches and is therefore cross-object and surprising. It remains anchored by the focus root's concealment branch and the woven construction, with the pearl sequence supplying both a discrete luminous unit and its shelter; downstream prose should mark it as a material analogy, not identify the couches with the companions.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Concealed interiority in the couch root combines with the modifier's interlaced envelope.

activation_trace.role: Provides an inwardly kept dimension within the focus noun.
Provides an interlaced exterior capable of holding protected units.
Contributes localized brilliance within the later comparison.
Contributes a sheltering cover that preserves what shines inside.

changed_reading.after: A protective weave whose value lies in preserving luminous interiority.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading uses the non-dominant split mapping from the reward root to cutting and hanging fiber, so its lexical route is form-distant and should never replace the direct recompense sense. It remains anchored in the focus's woven modifier and in the explicit deed-reward construction; render it only as a tentative craft analogy in which action yields material for the final support.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus support is explicitly constituted by interwoven material.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the outlier in an artifact made by joining many strands or units.
The split-root branch contributes cut fiber or suspended ornament as possible craft material.
Keeps the inferred material yield tied to intentional deeds rather than free imagery.
Retains the dominant act-for-return relation that contains the textile analogy.

changed_reading.before: The couches are finished objects granted as recompense.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the final support is woven from the gathered material yield of prior deeds.

strongest_changes: Tight interweaving becomes a constructive answer to the earlier sequence of shaking, fragmentation, and dispersal.
Placement on the couches installs elevation and favored proximity rather than merely supplying comfort.
The following bodily, face-to-face, and circular motions turn plural couches into a coordinated social topology.
The final speech restriction activates a protected interior maintained by harmless reciprocal utterance.
summary.what_was_special: Material opposition and post-focus grammar made the woven modifier operational: it could bear bodies, reverse dispersal, organize relations, and bound a speech environment instead of functioning as decoration alone.
remaining_uncertainties: The social and auditory extensions of material interweaving may exceed the adjective's immediate artisanal scope.
The protected-pearl transfer is cross-object and should remain analogical.
The textile-yield outlier depends on a deliberately retained non-dominant split-root branch.
